business_scope.primary_industry_name: High-Precision Steel Injection Molding of Color Snap-Fit Plastic Kits

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (unitary national law; Code civil and Code de commerce)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–China bilateral investment treaty and related supplementary agreements
France–United States income tax convention, as amended by applicable protocols
France–United Kingdom double taxation convention, as amended by applicable protocols

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 et seq. and R.561-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), as amended by the EU AML Directives 2015/849, 2018/843 and 2018/1673; Articles L.561-2, L.561-45 and R.561-51 et seq. CMonFin; Article R.123-151 of the French Commercial Code (Code de commerce); applicable RBE decrees and the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Private_Internal (limited access; competent authorities and obliged entities may inspect the RBE on a legitimate-interest basis; not publicly accessible)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport or national identity card of each individual shareholder and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National civil registry, police authority, or notary of the document holder's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing country is a Contracting State; otherwise Consular Legalization by the French Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address for each UBO, such as utility bill or bank reference letter
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local municipality, utility provider, or regulated bank in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization as applicable; alternatively certified by a notary in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized board resolution or power of attorney authorizing incorporation of the French SARL
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or notary of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization depending on the country of origin; accompanied by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn French translation of all UBO evidentiary documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified translator (traducteur agréé) or French consular translator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Translation certificate attached to the apostilled or legalized originals

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, managers, shareholders, UBOs and authorized signatories against the French FIU Tracfin watchlists, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council sanctions, and international PEP/sanctions databases. Where USD clearing is used, practical OFAC screening applies. For this Low_Risk_Standard manufacturing scope (ISIC 3240), standard customer due diligence is required; enhanced due diligence is mandatory if a PEP, high-risk jurisdiction or complex/nominee structure is identified.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Registre National des Entreprises via Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); availability cross-checked through Infogreffe and the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The dénomination sociale must be written in Latin characters; French is the official working language of the registry. Foreign-script names must be transliterated and may be accompanied by a French translation. The name must be available, distinctive, and must not create confusion with an existing RNE/RCS registration, protected trademark, or public body.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque / finance / assurance / fiduciaire / courtier (regulated financial terms requiring prior approval by ACPR or other financial supervisory authority)
République / État / National / Municipalité / Chambre de commerce (official or public-authority terms)
SARL / SA / SAS / EURL (legal-form abbreviations must reflect the actual form and cannot be used deceptively)
avocat / notaire / médecin / pharmacien / profession regulated by statute
Ordre / Académie / Institut / Union when likely to mislead the public
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection by Guichet Unique/INPI, the founder may submit a corrected corporate name through the same portal. Where rejection is based on a legal obstacle, the founder may file a written administrative appeal with the relevant commercial court registry within two months, annexing the refusal decision and legal arguments. If no appeal is filed, a new name may be reserved immediately. Where local greffe practice permits, the 120-day reservation may be renewed once; otherwise a fresh reservation request is required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not acceptable as sole commercial substance. A virtual or domiciled office can be used only where a regulated domiciliation company holds the required administrative authorization and occupies physical premises in France capable of receiving official mail and legal notices. Since the business scope covers high-precision steel injection molding and assembly of physical hobby kits, a real operational or production site is necessary to satisfy French commercial substance, VAT, customs, and employment-control requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High for production site: estimated 35–45% probability within the first 24 months of operations; low for a domiciliated registered office: approximately 5–10% unless tax or customs triggers require verification.

Apostille or consular legalization fees for foreign documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of the issuing country

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of incorporation notice in a legal announcements journal in the department of the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulated market tariff based on word count

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Guichet Unique/RNE company registration filing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle)/RNE

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year registered office domiciliation agreement or physical office deposit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial landlord or authorized domiciliation provider

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/PEP and sanctions screening system setup and compliance report preparation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 et seq. (SARL); Civil Code Articles 1832 and 1845-1; Decree No. 2023-150 of 2 March 2023 establishing the Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) kept by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, with filing operated through the Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) managed by INPI.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts constitutifs (Articles of Association) transmitted electronically as a Single Incorporation Dossier, evidenced by the certificate of filing (certificat de dépôt) on the Guichet Unique and thereafter by the Kbis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for a SARL under Article L.223-2; capital is freely fixed in the Statuts (recommended EUR 1,000). Under Article L.223-7, at least 20% of cash contributions must be paid up before filing, in-kind contributions must be fully paid up, and the balance must be paid within five years. The subscribed funds must first be deposited into a blocked attestation account held by a bank, a notary, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and are released only upon presentation of the Kbis extract after RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned sole shareholder of the SARL, acting pursuant to Articles L.223-1 et seq. of the French Code de commerce, hereby resolves: (1) approval of the draft Articles of Association; (2) full subscription of the share capital of EUR 1,000, divided into 100 shares of EUR 10 each, subscribed and released as to the legal minimum, the balance payable within five years; (3) adoption of the registered office at [Address], Paris, France; (4) appointment of Mr./Ms. [Name] as Gérant for an indefinite term, with all powers of management under Article L.223-18; (5) authorization for the Gérant to complete incorporation filings, deposit the capital, and obtain the Kbis extract. All statutory formalities are hereby ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the French Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate counsel or notaire (required if in-kind real-estate contributions); subsequent filing via Guichet Unique (INPI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Statuts in French containing corporate name, corporate object (high-precision steel injection molding of plastic snap-fit model kits under ISIC 3240), registered office address, share capital and classes, Gérant powers, distribution rules, and arbitration clause. Have each shareholder initial every page and sign the final deed; if a shareholder contributes real property, execute a notarized deed. After signature, the appointed Gérant prepares the required exhibits for filing.
required_dossiers: Identity document (ID card or passport) of each shareholder
Statuts signed by all shareholders
RIB (bank account details) of the shareholder depositing the capital
Lease agreement or domiciliation attestation issued by an approved domiciliation company
Declaration of beneficial owner (déclaration de bénéficiaire effectif)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe or INPI flags a statutory clause as non-compliant, adopt a supplementary deed (acte rectificatif) by shareholder decision and re-file the rectified Statuts within the cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed French bank, Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional account in the name of the company in formation, wire the subscribed cash capital, and obtain a certificate of blocked funds (attestation de dépôt des fonds or attestation du dépositaire) evidencing that at least 20% of cash contributions is paid up and the full subscribed amount is held. The depositary may release the funds only against production of the Kbis extract after RCS registration.
required_dossiers: Project of the Statuts
Identification of the person depositing funds
RIB (relevé d'identité bancaire)
Anti-money-laundering explanation of the source of funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account for risk reasons, switch to another licensed credit institution or use a notary's sequestration account (compte séquestre du notaire).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Legal Incorporation Notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Legal announcements gazette (Journal d'annonces légales, JAL) authorized in the department where the registered office is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Order publication of the mandatory notice containing the corporate form, name, object, capital, registered office, duration, Gérant identity, and RCS registry location; verify the draft against the requirements of the Commercial Code, and retain the attestation de parution issued by the gazette. The notice must appear before or on the day of filing the incorporation dossier.
required_dossiers: Draft legal announcement text
Extract of the Statuts (form, name, capital, registered office, manager)
Power of attorney from the Gérant to the gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is defective, cause a corrective publication (rectificatif) in the same or another JAL and re-file the attestation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing of the Single Incorporation Dossier
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) operated by INPI, transmitting to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, INSEE, and DGFiP
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: On the portal select 'Création d'entreprise' and complete the single form; upload the signed Statuts and exhibits; declare the beneficial owner; certify the exactitude of the data; pay the greffe rights and guichet unique fee (approximately EUR 73.31, USD 80) by card. The transmission automatically routes the dossier to the RCS Registry of the registered-office department.
required_dossiers: Signed Statuts (PDF)
Attestation de dépôt des fonds
Attestation de parution (JAL)
Attestation de domiciliation or copy of the registered-office lease
Identity document and address proof of the Gérant
Déclaration de bénéficiaire effectif (DBE)
Power of attorney if filed by counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is incomplete, INPI issues a demande de complément within 10 days; complete the missing items online within 30 days; otherwise the dossier is archived and must be re-filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration and Issuance of the Kbis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the Greffe validates the dossier, the company is entered in the commercial register and the Kbis extract (certificate of legal existence) is issued electronically, containing the SIREN number, SIRET of the head office and future establishments, code APE 3240Z, date of registration, and legal form. The same registration triggers INSEE and DGFiP tax registration and attribution of the French VAT number.
required_dossiers: Receipt of the accepted file from the Guichet Unique
Proof of payment of greffe rights
Approval of the legal controller if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If no response is received after 10 business days, file a written claim with the Greffier en Chef and use the Guichet Unique internal messaging; the Greffe must justify any refusal by a formal decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF, Service-Public Pro, and the insurance market
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Kbis is obtained, declare the nomination of the Gérant and his social regime through the URSSAF portal, open the employer account, and subscribe mandatory professional liability and property insurance (RC Professionnelle and multirisque atelier). Obtain the SIRENE confirmation and prepare the DUERP (Occupational Risk Assessment Document) before the first production run.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract
Identity and social security record of the Gérant
Proof of registered office
Insurance certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If URSSAF assigns a provisional SIRET, provide the definitive SIREN and SIRET without delay; if insurance is refused, apply to the Bureau Central de Tarification for compulsory civil liability cover.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) — Service des Installations Classées, within the French Ministry for Ecological Transition
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: ICPE Déclaration — Récépissé de déclaration for Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement under Rubrique 2661 (transformation de matières plastiques), Book V of the Environmental Code

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) in the territorial department where the manufacturing plant is located
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: ICPE Rubrique 2661 — Déclaration (D) regime for daily plastic throughput between 1 t and 10 t; Enregistrement (with a limited impact study) from 10 to 60 t/day; Autorisation regime (full EIA / étude d'impact) above 60 t/day; throughput below 1 t/day is non-classified (NC). DREAL delivers the filing receipt after examination of the declaration file.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the general prescriptions of the ministerial order of 2 February 1998 applicable to declared installations: wastewater discharged to sewer must respect pH 5.5–8.5, suspended solids ≤ 30 mg/L, COD ≤ 125 mg/L, and BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L; volatile organic compound emissions must not exceed 110 mg C/m3 in general ventilation; plastic rejects, molded scrap, and steel shavings must be sorted, stored in sealed containers on spill-resistant flooring, and transferred to authorized waste carriers with traceability slips (bordereaux de suivi).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance required under the Labor Code (arrêté of 25 June 1980) and the local safety commission: installation of fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and signage; electrical inspection certificate issued before first commissioning of the injection molding presses; structural load inspection of the floor for machinery exceeding 2 t/m²; preparation of the DUERP and workplace health plan under Article L.4121-1 of the Labor Code; CE marking conformity declaration for all machinery; consultation of the CSE once the workforce reaches 11 employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) - Official portal: impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must register a French SARL with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) to obtain SIREN/SIRET identifiers. Non-resident shareholders require appointment of a fiscal representative for tax compliance. VAT identification number (TVA) procured via DGFiP registration if turnover exceeds thresholds or for cross-border activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available in France. Hybrid mismatch elections governed by ATAD Directive; specific tax regime elections for certain holding structures or export-oriented entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: €85,000 of annual taxable turnover in France
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (facturation électronique) for all VAT-registered entities since October 2024; API integration with tax authorities for digital stamping, clearance, and compliance reporting.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported outside the EU qualify for 0% VAT rate upon proof of export. Offshore services to non-EU customers may qualify under territorial rules if performed abroad and invoiced accordingly.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en Douane d'Exportation - DAU)
Bill of Lading or CMR transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or equivalent proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Claims of zero-rating must be substantiated; fraudulent or unsubstantiated claims result in 40% penalty on evaded VAT, interest charges, and potential clawback of zero-rated amounts with full VAT liability plus administrative sanctions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) acting as the central bank and balance-of-payments authority, together with the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) for banking supervision, the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) for investment screening and the Commission Bancaire under the Code Monétaire et Financier.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is a fully convertible currency for both current and capital account transactions in France; free movement of capital applies under Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union and Articles L.221-1 and R.221-1 of the Code Monétaire et Financier. Profit remittances by a SARL to non-resident shareholders are not subject to FX control, but dividend distributions trigger France withholding tax, generally 25% on gross dividends absent a tax treaty or the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive, and cannot be made if accumulated losses would erode share capital; the legal reserve of at least 5% of annual net income must be funded until the reserve equals 10% of share capital.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no statutory surrender, repatriation or mandatory conversion requirement for export proceeds; foreign currency can be retained in a foreign-currency account or converted to EUR at the entity's discretion. However, all transfers of funds between France and third countries aggregating more than EUR 10,000 per calendar month per country must be declared through the Banque de France déclaration de transfert de fonds (DTF) process, and the Banque de France also collects direct investment balance-of-payments surveys when cross-border equity and loan flows exceed statutory reporting thresholds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (Compte de fonctionnement) for SWIFT MT103 settlements, FX forwards and Paypal settlement sweeps
Capital Escrow Account (Compte de dépôt de capital, séquestre) at constitution stage and Operational Account after Kbis registration
Operational Account with dedicated cash pooling for euro liquidity
Operational Account (Compte courant) with multi-currency functionality
Multi-currency Operational Account for USD/EUR/JPY trade settlement and commercial LC operations

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Cautiously feasible as a secondary rail: ACPR-regulated electronic money institutions such as Qonto, Shine, Revolut Business and Wise Business offer French IBANs and remote KYC opening, but they are not full credit institutions, are not covered by the Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts et de Résolution for deposits, cannot reliably issue or confirm documentary letters of credit for Asia-facing trade, and may impose lower value caps; therefore they are rated Medium for low-value PayPal sweeps and operational expenses, Low for the primary capital escrow and large MT103 treasury function.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Tier-1 French banks de facto require the SARL gérant, or at least one authorised signatory, to attend a physical onboarding interview at the bank's business centre with original identity documents; remote opening is legally possible under Directive 2018/843/EU and French R.561-12 through video identification, but is practically refused when a non-resident UBO or gérant has no French nexus. The robust practice is to present the gérant in person with two original identity documents, proof of address, and an authenticated Kbis extract under three months old.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident UBO/gérant with tax residence outside France and equity injected from a low or zero-tax jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled and notarised passport of each UBO, certificate of tax residence, source-of-wealth file comprising three years of personal or corporate bank statements, share subscription agreement, group structure chart, formal beneficial ownership declaration consistent with the Registre National des Entreprises and a business plan evidencing genuine manufacture of ISIC 3240 action figure mecha model kits in France

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered office at a domiciliation company instead of industrial premises
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Contrat de domiciliation registered with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, industrial lease or title deed for the injection-molding site, NAF/APE 32.40Z and INSEE registration extract, payroll or subcontracting invoices, TRACFIN due-diligence policy and invoiced proof that value is created in France

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: E-commerce retail and PayPal inflows flagged as potentially high-velocity or mule-related activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Order-to-bank reconciliation report mapping PayPal and SWIFT receipts to Shopify/Amazon/WooCommerce orders, carrier-issued delivery evidence, VAT and intrastat returns, chargeback and refund policy, customer KYB/KYC notes and periodic TRACFIN transaction monitoring output

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border capital increases above the EUR 10,000 monthly declaration threshold without Banque de France DTF evidence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised gérant or shareholders' resolution approving the capital increase, updated statuts, definitive share subscription certificates, bank statement evidencing the subscription amount, declaration of non-resident direct investment submitted through the receiving bank, and a signed undertaking to file the DTF each month where aggregated transfers exceed EUR 10,000 per country

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing is a SWIFT MT103 from the non-resident shareholder's bank to the SARL's operational account, payable in EUR or USD subject to a correspondent conversion leg, with remittance information coded as 'Apport en capital / souscription de parts' and the transaction categorised as an equity participation in the Banque de France balance-of-payments nomenclature; the receiving bank requires the corporate resolution, updated statuts and UBO register, and where monthly transfers with a single counterparty country exceed EUR 10,000 the DTF filing is executed via the Cedulam/eProc interface; no prior administrative authorisation is required because action-figure model-kit manufacturing under ISIC 3240 does not fall within France's strategic-sector control under Article R.151-1 Code Monétaire et Financier.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Factory settlements to Japanese and Chinese tooling suppliers flow through SWIFT MT103 EUR/USD cover or Telegraphic Transfer; large press-tool and raw-material purchases are supported by irrevocable documentary letters of credit issued by the French confirming bank under MT700 and governed by UCP600, with MT799 standby undertakings for advance-payment protection; intra-EU purchases of ABS/steel resins settle by SEPA Credit Transfer, while PayPal is used only for low-value B2C prototype and spare-part collections and is daily swept to the French operational account to avoid PM aggregate risk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD outright forward (achat à terme) to hedge USD-denominated steel and ABS resin purchases
EUR/CNH deliverable forward with onshore CNY reference and NDF (non-deliverable forward) referencing the CFETS fix for Chinese supplier settlements where CNY convertibility is restricted
EUR/JPY forward to hedge tooling royalties and license fees to Japanese mecha-rights holders
EUR/USD cross-currency swap to hedge multi-year capital expenditure and tool amortisation
EUR/USD FX swap (swap de change) to manage intra-mensuel liquidity phasing between supplier payments and Paypal sweeps

European-style vanilla FX options and zero-cost collars, permitted under MiFID II and the bank's derivatives eligibility policy, exclusively for hedging underlying commercial transactions and not for speculative open positions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders' meeting and approval of annual accounts (assemblée générale ordinaire annuelle)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Private corporate act; minutes recorded in the statutory minute book and filed with the RCS upon accounts deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the close of each financial year; for a 31 December year-end, the meeting must be held on or before 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene the meeting deprives the deposit of valid shareholder approval; the company is exposed to judicial injunction, coercive daily fines (astreinte), late-filing penalties, and ultimately court-ordered strike-off from the RCS for persistent default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual accounts and management report (dépôt des comptes annuels) with the Trade and Companies Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce via formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the shareholders' meeting and in any event within seven months of the financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end, on or before 31 July of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The registry issues a formal notice; continued failure allows the Public Prosecutor or any third party to petition the commercial court for an order to file, accompanied by a daily astreinte. Repeated non-compliance can result in judicial radiation from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax results return and schedules (liasse fiscale, form no. 2065/2050 series)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year SARL, e-filing is due by the second working day after 1 May of the following year; for a non-calendar financial year, within three months after the close of the financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a 10% penalty on the corporate income tax due, increased to 40% if no response follows a formal demand, plus late-payment interest of 0.20% per month and possible tax enforcement liens; it is not itself an RCS strike-off ground.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial-owner register declaration and ownership update (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce / RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial filing at incorporation and re-filing within 30 days after any change in beneficial ownership or shareholding structure; no separate annual filing if there is no ownership change, but consistency is verified at each annual accounts deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or omitted beneficial-owner information exposes the SARL to a criminal fine of up to EUR 75,000 (five times the EUR 15,000 personal-entity scale) and the manager to up to six months imprisonment; judicial injunctions and registration blocks may follow.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual local business property tax and change declaration (Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP acting on behalf of the local commune
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The annual CFE is payable by 15 December based on the assessed notice; declaration form no. 1447-C is required when the SARL commences or ceases business, and form no. 1447-S is required for changes in premises during the preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment or omission results in a 5% late-filing or late-payment increase plus additional monthly penalties; continued non-payment may authorise recovery by distraint on bank accounts, but does not directly trigger administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A French SARL must appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) if, at the end of the financial year, it exceeds two of the three following thresholds: total balance-sheet assets of EUR 4,000,000; net turnover of EUR 8,000,000; average workforce of 50 employees. Mandatory audit can also be required by court order at the request of minority shareholders or creditors and by legal-form obligations applicable to control relationships.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual statutory accounts of the SARL are prepared under French GAAP, principally ANC Règlement 2014-03 and the Plan Comptable Général. IFRS is not permitted for the standalone statutory accounts; IFRS is required only for consolidated financial statements of listed groups under EU Regulation 1606/2002.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not require a standalone annual UBO declaration when the ownership structure remains unchanged. The RCS beneficial-owner declaration must be filed at incorporation and updated within 30 days after any share transfer or event that causes a natural person to hold, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of capital or voting rights or otherwise to exercise control. At the annual accounts deposit the manager certifies that the beneficial-owner information on file remains true and accurate, and any inconsistency must be cured by an amended declaration within 30 days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Share Transfer / Securities Movement Register (Registre des mouvements de titres)
Minute Book (Registre des procès-verbaux des assemblées et décisions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 to USD 1,500 per year for commercial domiciliation services (EUR 250 to EUR 1,200), depending on Paris or provincial location, mail handling and meeting-room access.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 7,000 to USD 18,000 for a full statutory audit (EUR 6,000 to EUR 15,000); no audit fee is required where the SARL remains below the two-of-three threshold test and no other appointment ground exists.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% CIT rate on first EUR 42,500 of taxable income for small and medium-sized enterprises (EU definition); Crédit d'Impôt Recherche (CIR) equal to 30% of eligible R&D expenditure; Crédit d'Impôt pour la Compétitivité et l'Emploi (CICE) applies historically; participation exemption for qualifying dividends; reduced rates for overseas departments.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: CERFA No. 2065 (Déclaration de résultats) with liasse fiscale schedules 2052 to 2058, filed electronically on the impots.gouv.fr professional portal (Espace Pro) using EDI-TDFC or EFI-annuelle.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (exercice comptable); quarterly provisional instalments for corporate income tax on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September, and 15 December for calendar-year companies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months following the end of the fiscal year. For a calendar-year SARL, the filing deadline is 31 March of the following year; for a short accounting period, three months after the closing date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business activity (NAF code and descriptive name of the actual operations, including injection molding of snap-fit plastic kits for action figure and mecha model kits).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter NAF 32.40Z / ISIC 3240 and provide a French description of the French permanent establishment's activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income or deficit after accounting additions and deductions (résultat net fiscal) computed on the 2058-derived calculation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only the French-source profit attributable to the French P.E.; attach Form 2067-B for computation of PE profit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net long-term capital gains and losses (plus-values et moins-values à long terme).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gains on disposals of French business assets or shares for which the long-term regime applies; use Form 2100/2101 if applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Déficits reportables - losses brought forward and deducted against current year profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the amount of prior-year losses (carryforward) absorbed; for non-residents, only losses generated by the French PE can be offset.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or unfiled Return: 10% penalty of the net CIT due if filed within 30 days of deadline, 20% thereafter, plus 0.20% monthly late-payment interest (article 1730 CGI); automatic administrative penalty of EUR 150 for each omitted schedule or false declaration (article 1732 CGI); repeated non-filing can trigger assessment on an ex officio basis and criminal liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% for dividends paid by a French SARL to non-resident corporate shareholders under Article 119-2 CGI; 12.8% flat withholding for non-resident individuals plus 17.2% social levies (unless DTA exemption); 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive when a 10% shareholding and the required two-year holding commitment are proven.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply for a reduced DTA rate: (1) obtain a Form 5000 residency certificate (TRC) from the tax authority of the shareholder's residence; (2) transmit the TRC and Form 5001 to the French paying agent before distribution; (3) if the withholding was already applied, file a refund request with the DGFIP using Form 5000/2091 within the limitation period of the second calendar year after the payment; (4) for EU-directive relief, submit Form 2074 and evidence of the qualifying 10% holding for at least two years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: domestic withholding tax rate of 33.33% under Article 182 B CGI for patent, trademark, know-how, design, and manufacturing technique royalties; reduced to 0% under EU Interest-Royalty Directive between associated EU companies or to 5%-15% as provided in applicable DTA (or 10% under France-Germany DTA for some royalties). Interest: statutory 25% withholding under Article 119-1 CGI on interest paid to non-resident creditors; exemption for bank loans, bond issues, and certain purposive exceptions; DTA rates generally 0%, 10%, or 15%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 400 million in group consolidated annual turnover or total assets triggers mandatory Local File and Master File under Article L.13 AA CGI; EUR 750 million in group revenue triggers Country-by-Country Reporting under Article 223 quinquies C; French entities with EUR 50 million annual turnover (and intragroup operations) must provide a simplified file.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies no Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) as found in offshore centres; however, Article 57 CGI and the Article L.64 LPF abuse of right doctrine require genuine French economic substance. A French SARL must maintain real presence, staff, and operational control. Lack of substance may lead to re-attribution of profits to France, denial of treaty benefits under the principal purpose test, and 40% penalty for abusive tax mitigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately understating sales of mecha model kits or manufacturing services in the CIT return; fraudulent deduction of personal expenses as business costs; concealment of cash-swift or PayPal receipts and failure to include them in the audited accounting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine under Article 1741 CGI of EUR 250,000 for corporate offenders (fivefold: EUR 1,875,000) and up to five years' imprisonment; additionally administrative 100% penalty on evaded tax plus 0.20% monthly interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who orchestrating the fraud may be personally convicted, face travel bans, have personal assets frozen or seized, and may be held jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt when the SARL is a sham or used as a conduit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Willful Non-Filing and Tax Audit Obstruction
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Repeated failure to file Form 2065 after the three-month deadline; refusal to submit accounting records to DGFIP inspectors during a corporate tax audit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Ex officio assessment (taxation d'office) plus 10%/20% filing penalty and 0.20% monthly interest; EUR 150 fine per omitted form or false schedule; serious obstruction may lead to an order to close the company for up to five years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The manager may incur a personal fine of EUR 750 under Article 1732 CGI; if gross negligence is established, imprisonment of up to six months and a EUR 7,500 fine, a ban on management, and a travel ban can be imposed.
